source.title: REM sleep depotentiates amygdala activity to previous emotional experiences.

confidence_rationale: Canonical and widely cited demonstration of the readout MECH-018 calls TRAVERSABILITY -- overnight dissipation of amygdala reactivity to already-encoded emotional material, with REM physiology as the covariate. Source quality is good but not exceptional (single night, modest N, 2011, and the REM-gamma component of the result is correlational rather than manipulated). Mapping fidelity is the limiting term: the paper measures affective REACTIVITY to a re-presented stimulus, whereas MECH-018 measures the residue COST levied on a hippocampal proposal. These are analogous, not identical, so confidence is held below the source-quality figure.
failure_signatures: The study demonstrates reduced next-day amygdala reactivity but does not independently establish that the underlying memory was preserved, so it evidences readout (iv) far more strongly than readout (i); a residue field could produce this same signature by simple erasure, which is the exact failure mode MECH-018 pre-registers as FALSIFYING.
The REM-EEG association is correlational: no arm manipulated REM to show the dissipation follows it, so a third factor (time, wake rehearsal, adaptation to repeated presentation) is not excluded.

mapping.source_claim_statement: REM sleep physiology is associated with an overnight dissipation of amygdala activity in response to previous emotional experiences, altering functional connectivity and reducing next-day subjective emotionality; the proposed mechanism is the marked suppression of central adrenergic neurotransmission during REM combined with activation of amygdala-hippocampal networks that encode salient events.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-018 readout (iv), TRAVERSABILITY: after a sleep cycle, the fraction of hippocampal proposals rejected on residue cost should fall. The paper supplies the biological analogue -- the affective charge attached to an already-encoded episode is attenuated overnight while the episode itself remains recognisable and re-presentable. It also supplies the neuromodulatory story REE's sleep phases are built around: a low-noradrenaline window in which salient traces are reactivated and their affective weighting is re-set, rather than a window in which they are deleted.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper does not measure anything like a specificity ratio, so it says nothing about readout (ii); and its retention evidence is weak, so it cannot by itself distinguish integration from erasure. Read as support for (iv) only. The residue field is also a persistent scalar over z_world, whereas amygdala BOLD is a transient evoked response -- 'cost falls' and 'reactivity falls' coincide only if REE's residue cost is what drives proposal rejection, which is an architectural assumption, not a finding.
mapping.source_context: Healthy human adults; polysomnography plus fMRI; emotional image viewing before and after a night of sleep versus an equivalent waking interval.

confidence_components.notes: Weighted toward mapping_fidelity because MECH-018 is an architectural claim about what a sleep operation does to a field's geometry; the neuroscience is the analogy, not the measurement.
